subject: Summit partner consolidation — recommendation & next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Q3 Summit — vendor consolidation ask

Team —

As discussed in last week's marketing sync, leadership wants us to reduce the number of outside partners for the Q3 Summit (Sept 27–29) and consolidate work where possible to drive better SLAs and single-point accountability. Can each of you confirm:

- Which vendors are currently scoped for summit work (PR, design, on-site production, AV/event logistics).
- Contract end dates / renewals that affect the summit window.
- Any incumbents we should keep regardless of consolidation (legal/compliance reasons).

Goal: by end of June we want a recommended shortlist (1 primary + 1 backup) for PR/design/event production so procurement can start PoC/SOW negotiations in July.

Please attach any SOWs or current invoices you have. I can host a 30-minute vendor review next week if helpful.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Marketing Programs
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-22T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 Summit — vendor consolidation ask

Soojin —

Attached is the shortlist I promised (vendor_shortlist.pdf). Quick summary:

- PR: Lumos Creative — retainer through Nov 2026; strong B2B tech events experience.
- Design: Independent studio (Fjord & Co) — contract month-to-month; flexible but higher hourly.
- Event production: Kite Events — current PO expires Oct 2026; good on logistics but limited creative.

My recommendation: consider consolidating PR + design under Lumos if they can provide a design lead and reduce handoffs. Kite stays as production lead (on-site / AV) unless Lumos proposes a bundled production partner.

Attaching current SOWs and last invoice samples in the folder. Happy to join the vendor review.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Marketing Manager, Events
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: vendor_shortlist.pdf

From: Emma Park <proposals@lumoscreative.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Julian Park <julian@lumoscreative.com>
Date: 2026-07-05T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Lumos Creative — Summit 2026 consolidated proposal

Hi Soojin and Laura —

Thanks for sharing the brief. Lumos would love to be considered as the consolidated creative & PR partner for the Summit. Attached is a proposal that bundles: PR retainer (media outreach + speaker prep), event creative (stage design, on-screen assets, motion), and an optional design retainer to support pre-event marketing assets.

Key highlights:
- Single point of contact: Emma Park (lead producer)
- Discounted blended rate for bundled services (approx. 18% savings vs. separate engagements)
- Studio can staff a dedicated senior designer for the three months prior to the event
- We can integrate with Kite Events for logistics; we've worked with them previously.

Attached: Lumos_Proposal_Summit2026.pdf, SOW_Lumos_Retainer_v2.docx

Open to a short call this week to walk through the SOW and pricing.

Best,
Emma Park
Business Lead
Lumos Creative
proposals@lumoscreative.com

Attachments: Lumos_Proposal_Summit2026.pdf, SOW_Lumos_Retainer_v2.docx

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Park <proposals@lumoscreative.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lumos Creative — Summit 2026 consolidated proposal

Hi Emma — thanks for the proposal and the clear bundled pricing. A few questions from our side before we escalate to procurement/legal: 

1) Can you confirm whether the bundled price includes outsourced production coordination with Kite Events or if that remains a pass-through? We need clarity on single-vendor liability for on-site failures.
2) Is the senior designer a guaranteed dedicated resource or shared across clients? We need resource commitment for August–Sept.
3) Can Lumos accept our standard 45-day payment terms?

Aditya — tagging you to confirm procurement timelines and whether we can start SOW redlines this week.

Thanks,
Grace
Director, Demand Gen (Events)
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai

From: Emma Park <proposals@lumoscreative.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Julian Park <julian@lumoscreative.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lumos Creative — Summit 2026 consolidated proposal

Grace —

Thanks for the questions — answers below: 

1) Production coordination: We can include Kite Events coordination as part of the bundled scope and accept single-vendor liability for on-site delivery. We will add explicit acceptance criteria and an escalation path in the SOW.
2) Senior designer: confirmed dedicated for the account between Aug 1–Sept 30. Name/portfolio attached to the SOW.
3) Payment terms: we can move to Redwood's standard 45-day net terms on the retainer; vendor tooling integrations (stock images, third-party licensing) will be pass-throughs on invoices.

Updated SOW and a preliminary DocuSign link for the retainer are here: https://www.docusign.com/recipients/view/ABCDEF123456. We also attached a redlined SOW draft inline with the changes (SOW_Lumos_Retainer_v2.docx).

If this looks good, we can execute the retainer and start creative kickoff the week of Aug 17.

Best,
Emma Park
Business Lead
Lumos Creative
proposals@lumoscreative.com

Attachments: SOW_Lumos_Retainer_v2.docx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement <procurement@redwood.ai>, Legal <legal@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Emma Park <proposals@lumoscreative.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Approval to proceed — Lumos consolidated retainer (Summit)

Procurement / Legal —

We approved Lumos Creative as the consolidated partner for Summit 2026 (PR + event creative + coordination with Kite Events). Key points:

- Scope: PR retainer + dedicated design lead + production coordination (Lumos liable for on-site delivery per SOW).
- Term: Aug 15–Nov 30, 2026 (trial retainer covering the Summit window).
- Budget: $145,000 total retainer (see attached proposal for line items).
- Payment: Redwood net-45 terms accepted by vendor.

Please review the attached redlined SOW (SOW_Lumos_Retainer_v2.docx) and DocuSign envelope; Lumos has accepted our payment terms and resource guarantees. If procurement/legal need any additional clauses (indemnity, SLA credits), let us know by EOD Monday so we can keep the Aug 17 kickoff.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Marketing Programs
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOW_Lumos_Retainer_v2.docx, Lumos_Proposal_Summit2026.pdf
